title: Place
description: One record: a destination (country, region, city, town, neighbourhood, island, park or mountain) as a travel destination. Voyager use: destination context for every agent; discovery.

name.description: The place's name as written on the page.

place_type.description: What kind of place it is.

city.description: City in English. Always paired with `country`.

country.description: Country in English (e.g. "Japan"). Required whenever `city` is set.

region.description: State, province or region in English, if stated.

summary.description: Two or three neutral sentences on why travellers visit.

known_for.description: What the place is known for (e.g. "street food", "temples").

neighbourhoods.description: Areas a visitor would stay in or explore.

best_time_to_visit.description: The page's advice on when to go.

currency.description: Local currency ISO 4217 code, if stated.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone (e.g. "Asia/Tokyo") or UTC offset as stated.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, only if the page states coordinates.

lng.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, only if the page states coordinates.

official_tourism_url.description: The official tourism board site, if the page links it.

source_url.description: The page's own link for this item (official site, booking or detail page), copied verbatim from the page.

as_of.description: The "last updated", "valid from" or publication date the page itself states for this information (YYYY-MM-DD).

items.description: A verbatim quote from the page.

evidence.description: Up to 3 short verbatim quotes from the page that support the most important facts.
